# Bubbla eller inte? Peter Malmqvist om rapportperioden

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-11-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Peter Malmqvist (guest, EFN Börslunch) argues the late-October AI sell-off is a normal ~10% correction rather than the start of a crash: earnings of the largest US tech companies are still extremely strong, though rising long rates and debt-financed, capital-heavy AI capex are a risk he thinks could break the system in about a year (autumn 2027). For Stockholm, the Q3 report season is better than Q2, with six of eight sectors showing rising earnings, but the guest calls the valuation too high (P/E ~19 vs a long-run ~16), which explains the sharp negative reactions to small misses.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ PLTR — Palantir | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest can't model the P/E ~150 valuation and sets it aside; growth would require rates he knows won't happen.

#### Reasoning

Peter Malmqvist (guest) says Palantir's valuation needs growth rates over the next five years that he believes will not happen, so he cannot model it or explain what drives its value. He excludes it from consideration. This is a stated avoidance, not a short call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if earnings growth makes the valuation explainable in a normal model
- if P/E falls toward levels reasonable for the growth

> *"Palantir är ett bolag som jag inte begriper mig på."*

---

### 🟠 MSFT — Microsoft | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest sees huge earning power that is not breaking and a valuation low compared with its own 10-15 year history.

#### Reasoning

The guest says Microsoft's earning power is enormous and he can't see it breaking right now. He calls it normally or even low valued compared with its own 10-15 year history. He gives no explicit buy call, and the risks he names are rising rates and debt-financed AI capex weakening returns on capital.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI capex payoff fails and margins stop rising
- if rising long-term rates squeeze capital-heavy balance sheets

> *"Bolag som Microsoft, till exempel. Det är en enorm intjäningsförmåga."*

---

### 🟠 AAPL — Apple | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Report due tonight; guest is interested in it as an AI buyer, but the valuation is slightly above normal and he expects little from the foldable iPhone.

#### Reasoning

The guest calls Apple a profitable company valued slightly above its own normally high 10-year level. He finds the report interesting because Apple buys AI rather than produces it. He and the host do not expect much from the foldable iPhone 18, since foldables have only about 2-3% market share. Overall it is a neutral watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the foldable iPhone sells poorly
- if the valuation premium widens without earnings growth

> *"Men jag ser fram emot att se Apples rapport."*

---
